Android 开发者做 APK 发布时，加固基本已经成为很多项目的标准流程。
国内比较常见的方案包括 360 加固、腾讯乐固、梆梆加固 等，国外也有 DexGuard、DexProtector 等商业方案。
这些方案的共同特点是功能比较完整，但对于个人开发者、小团队以及预算有限的项目来说，成本、平台依赖和定制能力往往也是需要考虑的问题。
这也是我最近比较关注 XopProtector 的原因。

DEX Encryption
PVM1 Method Protection

SO Protection
RASP
Frida / Hook Detection
Integrity Protection
Windows GUI + CLI
项目本身同时包含加固引擎和 Android Native Runtime。
项目地址：
https://githu

The confusion is not your fault: IAM has a few pieces that sound similar (users, roles, policies, groups) and the relationships between them are not obvious. Let me explain it the way I wish someone had explained it to me, with no jargon until it earns its place.
IAM answers a single question for every request in your account: is this identity allowed to perform
